name: Silver Oak (India) Limited
summary: Silver Oak (India) Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of liquor in India. It provides various products, such as whiskey, vodka, rum, gin, tango, etc. The company offers its products under Liberty, Royal Crown, and Mister X brand names. It is also involved in the construction, development, and sale of residential real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Silveroak Blenders & Bottlers Ltd. and changed its name to Silver Oak (India) Limited in March 1996. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Indore, India. Silver Oak (India) Limited operates as a subsidiary of Royal Highland Distilleries Limited.
